title: Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine
wikitext:
[[File:Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine.jpg|thumb|300px|Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine]]

'''Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine''' is a deep mine located in the heart of [[Gol'Bolar Quarry]]. It was once a [[Dwarf|dwarven]] excavation site but, in the middle of a dig, the dwarves uncovered one of the underground caverns belonging to the [[trogg]]s. The troggs pushed the dwarves out, and also took over the quarry outside of the mine. As opposed to the lower-level troggs in the outer quarry, this mine holds some of their strongest numbers which includes their leader, [[Hammerspine]]. Enter with caution!
